messages:
natalie: Quick reminder  Kara's bday is this Friday (9/3). Thinking a tiny treat at 3pm or a virtual card + small donation to Kara's fav shelter. Thoughts? :tada:
kara: oh wow you remembered!! i'm happy with whatever everyone prefers. i'm probably remote but will pop in if needed. :blush:
omar: low-effort vote then: react :muffin: = 3pm office mini (boxed muffins), :card_index_dividers: = virtual card + donation, :white_check_mark: = opt out. keep it chill.
jin: if office then boxed muffins + tea sounds perfect. pls include at least 2 vegan options.
sophie: donation vote here  i can set up a $1-5 voluntary pool and send to Paws & Claws shelter. link: https://donate.example/paws
events-bot: POLL created "Kara celebration preference"  Options: 1) Boxed muffins @3pm 2) Virtual card + donation 3) Opt out. Voting window: 24h
omar: logistical note: if muffins win i can swing by Morning Crumbs at 2:40 and grab 20 mini muffin boxes. who can sign for delivery at reception at 2:55?
jin: i can sign for reception. also will bring a small table sign saying "Kara's Bday Treats" so people don't eat them all before 3pm :laughing:
sophie: poll update: 11 votes  6 :muffin:, 4 :card_index_dividers:, 1 :white_check_mark:
natalie: looks like muffins are leading. quick check: vegan options ok for everyone? jin said yes. kara any preference on flavours?
kara: surprise me! chocolate, banana, and lemon would be fun. no candles pls  allergies and heating issues. :)
omar: noted. no candles, individually boxed only. i'll cap spend at $45. sophie if donation poll close looks close maybe we do both: muffins + $30 donation?
sophie: i can do a $30 donation if we end up with extra contributions. i'll post a payment link after final tally.
events-bot: Poll closed. Winner: Boxed muffins @3pm. Final tally: 8 muffins, 5 card+donation, 2 opt-out.
natalie: awesome. plan: mar 2:40 pickup by Omar, reception sign-off by Jin, treats out at 3pm, Sophie will post donation link in this thread for anyone who wants to chip in for Paws & Claws. i'll draft a 1-line card blurb: "Happy Birthday Kara! Thanks for bringing warmth & smiles to the team." suggestions?
kara: that's perfect. thank you all, this is so sweet. no fuss needed but i'm touched <3 :heart:
